name: Takanashi Yumina
source:
"Yomina will protect you all!!"

She graduated with honors from Sosei Academi's All-girls Department. Back in school, students voted for her as the chief representative of Flores, as well as Mireti.

She is not genetically related to [url=/c41669]Mito Yuuri[/url]. But they once lived together, and therefore she admires him as a brother. Even though she still panicks when she gets nervous, her introverted personality has changed a bit, and she now accepts many new challenges.

[From [url=http://hikarifield.com/tayutama2_en/]English Website[/url]]

Precise height: 149.9 cm
